title: Minimize the Maximum Pair Sum
description: Pair every element of an even-length array with exactly one other element. The pair sum is the sum of its two values. Return the smallest possible value of the largest pair sum. Input: `nums`. Output: the minimized largest pair sum.
hints: Sort or count values once, then process each candidate in a single pass.
Check duplicates, all-equal inputs, and boundary values for `k`.
